[4:01PM] #PWD #TrafficUpdate 

 Vehicular movement from Iyana Dopemu through Ikeja Along to Bolade Oshodi is generally smooth, although minor delays are anticipated when approaching designated alternation points along this route.

The return journey from Bolade Oshodi to the Airport U-turn is proceeding well. However, slight congestion has been observed around the Airport U-turn.

Movement from the Airport U-turn towards the Airport bus stop is steady. Progress from the Airport bus stop through Ajayi farm and across the overpass is currently experiencing heavy traffic. This is attributed to a backlog of vehicles at the intersection on the overpass, compounded by pedestrian activity at the Ajayi farm crossing.

Beyond Ajayi farm, the flow of traffic towards Dopemu remains in good condition. No significant impediments have been reported, and our officers are present to manage the traffic flow as necessary.

#FollowLASTMA

[4:06PM] #Okota_Isolo #TrafficUpdate 

The counterflow system implemented along the stretch from Lasutech roundabout, extending through Limca junction, Aiye, Omonije, College, Ishaga, Mustapha, Ile Ibadan, Ire Akari, and Kogberegbe, is facilitating rapid traffic flow.

Similarly, traffic on Oke-Afa bridge, in both directions connecting to Pako, is moving swiftly. This efficient flow continues from Pako through Akiti and Chemist bus-stops for both inbound and outbound journeys.

Commuters utilizing the route from Ago roundabout towards Ibeh road are experiencing fast traffic conditions, with the return journey also reporting good movement. 

The stretch from Ilasa-Transformer to Apata junction is currently characterized by rapid traffic flow in both directions.
The Cele Ijesha link bridge is experiencing unimpeded traffic movement.

 Furthermore, the route from this bridge extending to Ijesha inward Mile 2 is also flowing freely. 
Traffic along the stretch from Cele, past Rain Oil petrol station, and connecting to Ago palace is moving at a brisk pace, with the return journey mirroring this condition.

Finally, traffic from 5 Star towards the under bridge at Iyana Isolo is flowing quickly. A fast and steady traffic condition is also observed on the Daleko-Mushin bridge. No impediments or obstructions to traffic have been reported within these areas. 

#FollowLASTMA

[4:30PM] #MobolajiBankAnthonyWay #TrafficUpdate 

Good movement along Anthony on the inward journey towards Maryland intersection en route to Odo Iyalaro. Similarly, Mobolaji Bank Anthony Way inward towards NITEL is experiencing favorable traffic movement. However, the section from NITEL towards Ikeja proper is currently experiencing higher traffic volume due to ongoing commercial activities along Awolowo Way in Ikeja, although traffic is still moving.

Regarding other routes, traffic movement from LASUTH underneath the bridge towards Kodesoh Road is presently heavy due to commercial activities in the area. Conversely, the return journey from Kodesoh inward towards LASUTH is proceeding smoothly. 

Within Ikeja GRA, Oba Akinjobi Way inward towards the Police College is experiencing good traffic flow, but the return journey from the Police College through LASUTH underneath the bridge down to Kodesoh Road is encountering heavy traffic as a result of commercial activities; traffic personnel are present to manage the situation.

Finally, the Oba Akran link bridge and the local Airport link bridge are both clear with no reported congestion. Our officers are stationed at various points of potential congestion within the zone to ensure the smooth flow of vehicles.

#FollowLASTMA

[4:40PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

 Motorists descending from CMS bridge towards Offin canal are experiencing slow movement due to significant market activity and a high volume of vehicles. However, immediately after the Offin canal, the flow towards Eko bridge by Nepa is moving smoothly. 

Similarly, traffic flow on Eko bridge by Nepa heading towards CMS bridge is currently good. For those descending Eko bridge towards Elegbeta Mini stadium and the Ebute-Ero market, the traffic situation is also currently favorable. 

Travel from Carter bridge inwards Ebute-Ero market and along Leventis, through the UBA roundabout, connecting to both inner and outer Marina, is proceeding without significant delays. In contrast, there is slow movement reported on Broad Street, extending to Apongbon underneath the bridge, specifically affecting the connection to the Offin Canal market area. 

Overall, no major impediments have been identified at this time, and our personnel are present at key locations to manage the flow.

#FollowLASTMA

[4:52PM] #TrafficUpdate #Mile12 #IkoroduRoad 

 Vehicular traffic from Iyana School, through Kosofe, and onwards to Mile 12 is flowing well. Traveling towards the east, both ascending and descending the Mile 12 bridge, the route inward  Owode Elede, Owode Onirin, and the weighbridge is clear. However, upon approaching Idera, motorists will encounter moving traffic.

 Beyond Idera, the journey towards Irawo, Thomas, Ajegunle, and Odo Ogun is proceeding very smoothly. For those traveling in the opposite direction, the return journey from Odo Ogun stretching back through Kosofe and Ile-Ile is reported to be operating without significant delays. 

Our personnel are present and actively monitoring the situation to ensure continued smooth flow.

#FollowLASTMA
